entities.summary: Abu 'Abd Allah Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn al-'Abbas al-Fakihi was an eminent 9th-century historian and hadith scholar of Mecca. He narrated hadiths from preeminent hadith scholars such as Muhammad Ibn Ismail al-Bukhari, Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj, Abu Hatim al-Razi and Abu Zur'ah Jurjani.
